Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: An official callback inquiry submitted by an onsite visitor.

name.description: Full name of the contact person.

email.description: Verified email address of the lead.

phone.description: Primary voice or messaging phone number.

service.description: The specific product module or general topic of inquiry.

JobApplication.title: JobApplication
JobApplication.description: A candidate job application submitted from the careers page.

phone.description: Mobile phone number of the applicant.

experience.description: Applicant experience level (e.g., Student/Intern, Fresher, Junior, etc.).

message.description: Motivation message or resume drive link.

resumeData.description: Base64 or data URI payload of the uploaded resume document.

resumeUrl.description: Direct link or Google Drive URL for the resume.

inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: A collection containing all onsite consultation leads and callback submissions.

job_applications/{jobApplicationId}.description: A collection containing all career job applications and resume submissions.
